title: Delegate one bounded investigation
summary: Give one worker a narrow evidence question, inspect the return, and keep the parent accountable for the recommendation.
originNote: A conventional delegation control that distinguishes clean handoff from outsourcing the final judgment.

setup.instructions: Mount the closed comparison packet at packet/. The harness must expose a real worker/delegation tool; otherwise mark this recipe unsupported rather than simulating a worker.

turns.content: Use exactly one worker to answer the bounded question in packet/worker-question.md from the supplied sources. Give it an explicit evidence and return contract. When it returns, inspect at least one cited source yourself, then write output/recommendation.md. The parent response owns the recommendation and names any unresolved evidence.

checks.description: Look for exactly one real worker with a bounded return contract, followed by parent inspection.
The parent-authored recommendation cites a source and names the missing compatibility fact.

variation: Change the narrow research question and missing evidence while retaining one worker and parent-owned synthesis.
